fields.name: valid
fields.semantic: snapshot slot contains a completed record

fields.name: slot_index
fields.semantic: zero-based slot index 0..15

fields.name: frame_id
fields.semantic: expected_frame_id latched at frame_start

fields.name: frame_start_seen
fields.semantic: one because capture requires frame_active_q

fields.name: core_busy_at_session_done
fields.semantic: core_busy sampled at session_done

fields.name: core_done_seen
fields.semantic: core_done observed since frame_start

fields.name: session_done
fields.semantic: session_done sampled at capture edge

fields.name: uart_final_idle
fields.semantic: UART transmit and readback both idle at sample

fields.name: input_accept_count
fields.semantic: C-to-B valid && ready handshakes including frame_start edge

fields.name: output_accept_count
fields.semantic: B-to-C valid && ready handshakes including frame_start edge

fields.name: stripe_last_accept_count
fields.semantic: accepted B output stripe_last beats

fields.name: frame_last_accept_count
fields.semantic: accepted B output frame_last beats

fields.name: uart_bytes_delta
fields.semantic: UART byte count at session_done minus count latched at frame_start

fields.name: core_proto_error
fields.semantic: sticky source status sampled at completion

fields.name: core_overflow_error
fields.semantic: sticky source status sampled at completion

fields.name: loader_protocol_error
fields.semantic: sticky source status sampled at completion

fields.name: loader_frame_error_count
fields.semantic: cumulative loader frame error count since reset

fields.name: uart_framing_error_count
fields.semantic: cumulative UART framing error count since reset

fields.name: core_span_cycles
fields.semantic: frame_start through first observed core_done, inclusive

fields.name: last_input_cycle
fields.semantic: frame-relative cycle of expected final input handshake, else zero

fields.name: last_output_cycle
fields.semantic: frame-relative cycle of expected final output handshake, else zero

fields.name: session_done_cycle
fields.semantic: frame-relative cycle number at session_done including capture edge

fields.name: output_blocked_cycles
fields.semantic: frame_active cycles with B out_valid && !out_ready

fields.name: b_input_wait_cycles
fields.semantic: busy cycles below expected input count with c2b_valid low

fields.name: c2b_stall_cycles
fields.semantic: frame_active cycles with c2b_valid && !c2b_ready

fields.name: joint_stall_cycles
fields.semantic: intersection of output blocked and B input wait cycles

fields.name: c2b_hold_violation_count
fields.semantic: C-to-B payload instability after a sampled stall

fields.name: b_output_hold_violation_count
fields.semantic: B-to-C data or sideband instability after a sampled stall

fields.name: pause_request_cycles
fields.semantic: frame_active cycles with pause_active

fields.name: pause_forced_block_cycles
fields.semantic: frame_active cycles with pause_forced_block

fields.name: pause_active_at_done
fields.semantic: pause_active sampled at session_done
